chunks: And in another report: “If that is his shooting instrument, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.آخَرَ: another, indicating a separate transmitted report
key_terms.تِلْكَ: that, referring to the instrument in question
key_terms.كَانَتْ: was or is, introducing the condition
key_terms.مِرْمَاتَهُ: his shooting or throwing instrument used for hunting

ai.seo_question: When is there no harm in using a hunting instrument according to this report?
ai.summary: This report conveys a legal ruling related to hunting, indicating permissibility when the object used is the person's recognized shooting instrument. The phrase "there is no harm" signifies allowance in this juristic context.
